entries.81dc6833d250d03e: A single-segment business that supports clients in solving their challenges by combining technologies such as cloud, AI, and IoT. It offers two ways of engaging with the same clients: flow-type support, which covers everything from defining challenges through design and implementation to operation, and stock-type support, which continuously solves operational challenges. Revenue for the fiscal year ended June 2026 was ¥2,407 million. As of June 30, 2026, the number of employees was 146, of whom 139 work at the head office and satellite offices, etc. (Chuo-ku, Fukuoka City), and 7 work at the Tokyo branch (Minato-ku, Tokyo). The company also has an affiliate not accounted for under the equity method, Tengo Jozosho Co., Ltd. (manufacture and sale of other brewed alcoholic beverages).

entries.a6d1deaaff6130d8: This is a service that provides a combination of diverse digital technologies across the board, including construction of cloud environments, system development, IoT-based data collection and AI-based data analysis. Revenue for the fiscal year ended June 2026 was ¥1,240 million.
